name: A-field measurement and VHF through-rock/underwater communication experiment

mentions.name: A-field measurement and VHF through-rock/underwater communication experiment
mentions.description: This is a personal physics research project investigating the electromagnetic A field in electrodynamics and affordable ways to measure it, with the goal of achieving high-bandwidth VHF communication through rock or sea water. The author is using AI tools to work through the physics involved.
mentions.problem: Communicating through a wall of rock or sea water at VHF frequencies with high bandwidth, and measuring the electromagnetic A field at an affordable price.
mentions.source_excerpt: Fringe physics: Trying to understand WTF the A field is in electrodynamics, and how I can measure it for a price I can afford. Specifically, I want to communicate through a wall of rock or sea water at VHF frequencies, with high bandwidth.
